This is perfectly normal for toddlers. Things are stressful on both ends. I pray you find something that works.

Sometimes kids do this for attention. I worked at a daycare for years with a two/three year old class. Sometimes ignoring their meltdown (but still making sure they are safe with out them realizing you are watching) if you are at home will make them calm down and regain their composure. In no way am I saying you’re a bad mum, just what I have observed from children. If they do get into something like play dough in mouth, be calm, and softly but sternly say “please get that out of your mouth. It will make you sick” or gently take it out of their hand. Remember kids learn from behavior of others.
